Delivery Driver (Class 5) – Swift Parcel Co.
Swift Parcel Co. is a fictional local courier. We deliver for 200+ small businesses across the region.

Responsibilities
- Load your van each morning and plan your route with our app
- Deliver 80-120 parcels a day safely and on time
- Scan every package and collect signatures or photos
- Do a daily vehicle check and report any problems
- Be polite and helpful with customers at the door

Requirements
- Valid Class 5 licence with a clean driver's abstract
- Able to lift up to 25 kg and be on your feet all day
- Comfortable using a smartphone and GPS
- Good sense of direction and time management

Pay: $21/hour plus fuel card. Company van provided.
